# api-permission-precheck API reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/documentation.cjs. Do not edit. -->

Delegated-scope diagnostics do not grant access or replace server authorization.

## SPFxApiPermissionPrecheckOptions

Controls automatic checks, authentication interaction and token evaluation.

### Imports

```ts
import type { SPFxApiPermissionPrecheckOptions } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { SPFxApiPermissionPrecheckOptions } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/hooks';
```

### Examples

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { SPFxApiPermissionPrecheckOptions, useSPFxApiPermissionPrecheck } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

function Example() {
  const options: SPFxApiPermissionPrecheckOptions = { autoCheck: false, mode: 'passive', timeoutMs: 10000 };
  const permissions = useSPFxApiPermissionPrecheck({ graph: ['User.Read'] }, options);
  return <span>{permissions.configurationState}</span>;
}
```

### Members

| Member | Type | Requirement | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SPFxApiPermissionPrecheckOptions.autoCheck` | `boolean \| undefined` | Optional, readonly | true | Automatically checks when the token provider is ready and requirements/options change; omitted or undefined uses true. |
| `SPFxApiPermissionPrecheckOptions.mode` | `SPFxApiPermissionPrecheckMode \| undefined` | Optional, readonly | 'passive' | Omitted or undefined uses passive: resource acquisition is sequential and available popup/redirect events are cancelled for the check. interactiveAllowed does not install that guard; the provider controls actual interaction. |
| `SPFxApiPermissionPrecheckOptions.timeoutMs` | `number \| undefined` | Optional, readonly | 15000 | Per-resource token acquisition timeout in milliseconds; omitted or undefined uses 15000. Does not cancel the underlying provider request. |
| `SPFxApiPermissionPrecheckOptions.useCachedToken` | `boolean \| undefined` | Optional, readonly | true | Allows cached tokens unless false; omitted or undefined uses true. |
| `SPFxApiPermissionPrecheckOptions.validateAudience` | `boolean \| undefined` | Optional, readonly | true | Checks expected audiences unless false; omitted or undefined uses true. |

## SPFxApiPermissionPrecheckResult

Permission diagnostics and retry operations. The latest-started check publishes state; obsolete/unmounted completions still settle their promises but cannot publish results. Diagnostics do not grant access.

### Imports (2)

```ts
import type { SPFxApiPermissionPrecheckResult } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { SPFxApiPermissionPrecheckResult } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/hooks';
```

### Examples (2)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { SPFxApiPermissionPrecheckResult, useSPFxApiPermissionPrecheck } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

function Example() {
  const permissions: SPFxApiPermissionPrecheckResult = useSPFxApiPermissionPrecheck({ graph: ['User.Read'] });
  console.log(permissions.configurationState, permissions.missing);
  return <span>{permissions.configurationState}</span>;
}
```

### Members (2)

| Member | Type | Requirement | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SPFxApiPermissionPrecheckResult.available` | `readonly SPFxApiPermissionSummary[]` | Required, readonly | — | Requirements evaluated as available. |
| `SPFxApiPermissionPrecheckResult.check` | `() => Promise<readonly SPFxApiPermissionCheckResult[]>` | Required, readonly | — | Runs a check with the configured cache preference. |
| `SPFxApiPermissionPrecheckResult.configurationState` | `SPFxApiPermissionConfigurationState` | Required, readonly | — | Aggregate diagnostic state, including idle, checking and actionRequired. |
| `SPFxApiPermissionPrecheckResult.isChecking` | `boolean` | Required, readonly | — | True while the latest check is pending. |
| `SPFxApiPermissionPrecheckResult.isConfigured` | `boolean` | Required, readonly | — | True when every required evaluated result is available. Empty/no-required results also yield true, even while configurationState is idle/checking; does not establish server authorization. |
| `SPFxApiPermissionPrecheckResult.missing` | `readonly SPFxApiPermissionSummary[]` | Required, readonly | — | Required unavailable requirements with actionable missing/blocked access diagnostics. |
| `SPFxApiPermissionPrecheckResult.results` | `readonly SPFxApiPermissionCheckResult[]` | Required, readonly | — | Detailed per-scope diagnostics; no raw tokens are included. |
| `SPFxApiPermissionPrecheckResult.retry` | `() => Promise<readonly SPFxApiPermissionCheckResult[]>` | Required, readonly | — | Repeats check with the configured cache preference. |
| `SPFxApiPermissionPrecheckResult.retryWithoutCache` | `() => Promise<readonly SPFxApiPermissionCheckResult[]>` | Required, readonly | — | Repeats check requesting uncached tokens; the passive/interactive mode still applies. |
| `SPFxApiPermissionPrecheckResult.tokenProviderError` | `Error \| undefined` | Required, readonly | — | Token-provider initialization error, independent of per-scope check diagnostics. |
| `SPFxApiPermissionPrecheckResult.unknown` | `readonly SPFxApiPermissionSummary[]` | Required, readonly | — | Required unavailable requirements without an actionable missing-permission diagnosis. |
| `SPFxApiPermissionPrecheckResult.warnings` | `readonly SPFxApiPermissionSummary[]` | Required, readonly | — | All unavailable optional requirements; they do not block isConfigured. |

## useSPFxApiPermissionPrecheck

Checks delegated scopes using the provider's AadTokenProvider. Auto-check defaults to true and mode to passive. Requirement/provider changes reset results; latest checks publish state, without cancelling underlying requests. Token failures become diagnostics.

### Imports (3)

```ts
import { useSPFxApiPermissionPrecheck } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import { useSPFxApiPermissionPrecheck } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/hooks';
```

### Use when

- setup UI needs delegated-scope diagnostics and actionable retry results.

### Avoid when

- the application needs proof that a server request will succeed; token diagnostics do not grant access.

### Throws (7)

- When called outside an SPFx provider.

### Examples (3)

#### Basic usage

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { useSPFxApiPermissionPrecheck } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

function PermissionStatus() {
  const permissions = useSPFxApiPermissionPrecheck({ graph: ['User.Read'] });
  return <span>{permissions.configurationState}</span>;
}
```

#### Compare a gate and manual passive recheck

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { useSPFxApiPermissionPrecheck } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
function OrdersPermissionGate({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const precheck = useSPFxApiPermissionPrecheck({ graph: ['Sites.Read.All'], customApis: [{
    name: 'Orders API', resource: 'api://contoso-orders-api', packageResource: 'Orders API', scopes: ['Orders.Read'],
  }] });
  return precheck.configurationState === 'ready' ? <>{children}</> : <section>
    <p>{precheck.isChecking ? 'Checking API access' : precheck.configurationState}</p>
    {precheck.missing.map(item => <p key={item.id}>{item.adminMessage}</p>)}
  </section>;
}
function ManualPermissionCheck() {
  const precheck = useSPFxApiPermissionPrecheck({ graph: ['Sites.Read.All'] }, { autoCheck: false, mode: 'passive' });
  return <div><button disabled={precheck.isChecking} onClick={() => void precheck.check().catch(console.error)}>Check now</button>
    <button disabled={precheck.isChecking} onClick={() => void precheck.retryWithoutCache().catch(console.error)}>Recheck without cache</button>
    <pre>{precheck.configurationState}</pre>
  </div>;
}
```

### Signatures (4)

```ts
(config: SPFxApiPermissionPrecheckConfig, options?: SPFxApiPermissionPrecheckOptions | undefined): SPFxApiPermissionPrecheckResult
```

#### Parameters

- `config`: Graph/custom API requirements; keep data immutable when changing requirements.
- `options`: Automation/auth settings; omitted or undefined uses auto-check, passive mode, cached tokens, audience validation and 15000 ms timeout.

Aggregate state, detailed diagnostics and explicit retry methods.
